title: Courier to Haven: 5,000 cr once at Sol Central, the diplomatic silver delivered to the Grand Exchange: a Nebula-born trader's paid way home
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 10:08 UTC (orders ENT-081, block MERCURY: far_ok to the main corridors; rules F34 tier 4, F12, F37). Sol Central's board (data/missions/confederacy_central_command.json, read 09:17 UTC): Courier to Haven, 'Deliver diplomatic silver to the Grand Exchange at Haven' (5 silver_ore), 5,000 cr, 300 Piloting XP, 20 Trading XP, 25 Navigation XP. No Sol-region station asks silver ore (table books 10:05 UTC), so the route buys nothing: whether the mission hands the silver out on accept is the test (a delivery accepted with an empty hold is the only proof, trade-books lessons). One ship, one result; the road is join-sol-trader's (13 jumps, 0 pirates in 24 h). The ship ends at its capital either way, where home-grand-exchange would take it.
